page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7ne.2xlarge is an x86_64 general-purpose virtual machine running on the KVM hypervisor within the Enhanced server family. It is equipped with an Intel Xeon 8369HB processor running at 3.3 GHz, offering 8 vCPUs distributed across 4 dedicated physical cores with 2 threads per core. Memory capacity totals 32.0 GB, maintaining a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 4.0 GB RAM per vCPU. The instance carries 33 MB of L3 cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and features instruction set support including AVX-512 (with VNNI and BF16) and AES-NI. No local storage or discrete graphics accelerators are provided, requiring the configuration of external network-attached block storage for persistence.

Benchmark outcomes for the ecs.g7ne.2xlarge consistently position the instance in the middle 50% across measured compute, memory, and application profiles. In CPU benchmarks, the system achieved a stress-ng score of 1563.99 for single-core and 8283.11 for multi-core, complemented by a Geekbench multi-core score of 5125.0 and PassMark CPU score of 9694.64. Uncached memory performance registered 59.02 GB/sec for large-block reads and 40.88 GB/sec for writes. In application benchmarks, it yielded 8.0 million Redis SET operations per second and 7.87 GB/sec static web serving throughput alongside a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

The instance delivers a balanced hardware ratio well aligned with mainstream cloud architecture, avoiding resource bottlenecks in either direction. The lack of bundled local NVMe storage and complementary public IPv4 addresses introduces a dependency on external cloud storage and networking constructs, which should be factored into deployment planning. Its processing power and balanced memory make it a functional fit for containerized microservices, middle-tier enterprise web servers, CI/CD compilation workloads, and medium-scale caching or transactional database services.
